title: Adaptive Bayes exactly tracks information over intrinsic time
abstract: arXiv:2607.08789v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bayesian and multiplicative-weights updates reweight experts, models, or actions from sequential feedback. We show that the regret of any such update obeys an exact information-accounting identity. On each round, the learner's excess loss to any chosen comparator is the sum of an immediate cost for the uncertainty exposed by the round and a reduction in the information distance from the learner's current weights to the comparator. The cumulative cost defines a pathwise uncertainty clock, the intrinsic time of the realized sequence. Summing one-step balances yields two exact adaptive decompositions of cumulative regret, one for each natural way of composing the update across rounds. Because the decompositions are exact, favorable stochastic or low-noise regimes appear as self-bounding properties of the realized intrinsic time. translated_title: 自适应贝叶斯在内在时间上精确追踪信息
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.08789v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：贝叶斯和乘法权重更新方法通过序列反馈对专家、模型或行动进行重新加权。我们证明了任何此类更新的遗憾遵循一个精确的信息核算恒等式。在每一轮中，学习者在任何选定比较器上的超额损失等于该轮暴露不确定性的即时成本与从学习者当前权重到比较器的信息距离减少之和。累积成本定义了一个路径依赖的不确定性时钟，即实现序列的内在时间。将单步平衡求和，可得到累积遗憾的两种精确自适应分解，每种对应跨轮次组合更新的自然方式。由于分解是精确的，有利的随机或低噪声情景表现为实现内在时间的自界性质。该核算还固定了一个学习率，其与内在时间的平方根成反比。该调度是完整的。
tldr: 本文提出了一种精确的信息核算恒等式，将贝叶斯和乘法权重更新的遗憾分解为即时成本与信息距离减少之和，并基于内在时间自适应调整学习率，从而在随机或低噪声条件下实现自界性能。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact information-accounting identity for Bayesian and multiplicative-weights updates, decomposing regret into immediate cost and information distance reduction, and adapts the learning rate inversely to the square root of intrinsic time, yielding self-bounding properties in stochastic or low-noise regimes.
